notes: Only exact first-party tag/docs+Git blob verified references may be promoted from the research queue into records; all remain unexecuted and not v2 fixtures.
Dataset latest is the pinned historical CSV value; an exact public registry hit does not verify a transition.
Production admission requires separately merged first-party positive and negative receipts plus review/signing/reader gates.

sourceBackedBehavior: Official v22.0.0 changelog removes ESLint v8 and legacy .eslintrc support, requiring flat config evaluation.
In v22 the prefer-on-push-component-change-detection rule now reports explicit opt-outs (Eager/Default) rather than merely omitted changeDetection; rule enters recommended config.
The source monorepo manifest tightens ESLint peer from v8/v9 to v9/v10; published package metadata must be checked separately.
applicability: Projects upgrading exact angular-eslint major 21 to 22; inspect actual ESLint config entrypoint and installed versions before making a fix.
Rule rewrite applies only where source has affected component annotations or extends recommended; never automatically rewrite unrelated Angular code.
controlsRecommendedNotRun: ESLint 8 + legacy .eslintrc negative; ESLint 9/10 + flat config positive, exact installed npm peers.
Rule lint positive/negative against missing vs explicit changeDetection annotation; avoid claiming Angular v22 source semantics without recipient testing.

sourceBackedBehavior: The tagged v5.0.0 source manifest excludes Vite 7, unlike tagged v4.0.0, and requires Vite 8 prerelease-or-newer semver range.
The tagged v5 README documents opt-in virtual module virtual:css-injected-by-js for deferred CSS injection, not proof that every existing build must adopt it.
applicability: Exact migration 4.0.0→5.0.0 only; inspect installed Vite version, plugin config and bundler build output.
Source tree documents Vite8 peer expectation, not an independent observed npm ERESOLVE or compatibility test.
controlsRecommendedNotRun: Held Vite 7 strict peer-resolution negative and Vite 8 pinned positive, compare frozen lockfiles and CSS-injected build output.
Test static CSS, dynamic import and Shadow DOM behavior before recommending virtual-module changes.
